scripts.cluster-down: WITH_SYSTEM=0 LOCAL_CLUSTER=${LOCAL_CLUSTER:-$(uv run scripts/render.py --name)-local} bash scripts/local-cluster.sh down
scripts.validate: GATE_NAME=validate uv run scripts/render.py --check && dir=$(mktemp -d) && kustomize build cluster > "$dir/cluster.yaml" && kubeconform -strict -ignore-missing-schemas -schema-location default -schema-location 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datreeio/CRDs-catalog/main/{{.Group}}/{{.ResourceKind}}_{{.ResourceAPIVersion}}.json' -summary "$dir/cluster.yaml" > "$dir/report"; rc=$?; cat "$dir/report"; if [ $rc -eq 0 ] && grep -q '^Summary: 0 resource' "$dir/report"; then bash scripts/gate.sh nothing validate '0 resources' 'run `devbox run render` and check that cluster/kustomization.yaml lists resources'; rc=1; fi; rm -rf "$dir"; exit $rc
scripts.secrets-scan: bash scripts/gate.sh files secrets-scan . && git ls-files -z | xargs -0 detect-secrets-hook --baseline .secrets.baseline.json --disable-filter detect_secrets.filters.gibberish.should_exclude_secret
scripts.secrets-baseline: grep -qs is_line_allowlisted .secrets.baseline.json || detect-secrets scan --disable-filter detect_secrets.filters.gibberish.should_exclude_secret > .secrets.baseline.json; detect-secrets scan --baseline .secrets.baseline.json --disable-filter detect_secrets.filters.gibberish.should_exclude_secret
scripts.ci: devbox run validate && devbox run check && devbox run security && if grep -qs '"ci-extra"[[:space:]]*:' devbox.json; then devbox run ci-extra; fi
